incident_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.

result.scene_summary: A rural landscape under a massive, dark cloud formation, with a house and trees visible in the foreground and smoke rising from the horizon.

observations.description: Large plume of dark, billowing smoke rising from the horizon, obscuring the sky and landscape.
A house with a gabled roof and porch is visible on the right side of the image, surrounded by trees.
A line of dark evergreen trees is visible along the left side of the horizon, with other trees scattered in the foreground.
The sky is filled with heavy, grey storm clouds, with darker smoke plumes dominating the center and right portions of the frame.
